_doc: Who the positions pipeline tracks. Candidate ids and names come from src/data/fr-polling-2027.json; this file only adds party, birth year (used to tell homonyms apart when matching chamber members) and historical figures. Orbit members go in `orbit` with orbit_of and orbit_weight (0.3–0.5: 0.5 = party head / campaign chief / co-leader, 0.4 = group president, party officer or spokesperson, 0.3 = narrower ally), a one-line `justification` and a `source` page (checked by orbit_check.py, which also fills birth_year); a person has one `orbit_of` only. `orbit_existing` lists people already tracked as candidates who also count as orbit of another candidate (not stored in the database: the site builder reads it). `external_ids` pins a match by hand when the automatic name match is wrong or ambiguous.

emmanuel-macron.name: Emmanuel Macron
emmanuel-macron.note: In a few 2027 poll scenarios but barred from a third consecutive term: tracked as historical.
